summary: David says, The fool says there is no God—There is none who does good—Gathered Israel will rejoice.
meta_description: David says, The fool says there is no God—There is none who does good—Gathered Israel will rejoice.
section_headings: To the chief Musician upon Mahalath, Maschil, A Psalm of David.

footnotes.note6_a: OR delivers His people from captivity.
